speaker_count_note: AudioMNIST is 48 male / 12 female speakers dataset-wide, but this analysis follows the 'speaker-disjoint SI test fold for everything' discipline: the whitened direction was fit ONLY on the 12 SI test speakers, so correlations here use that same fold -- n=9 male / n=3 female speakers (4500 / 1500 utterances), not the dataset-wide 48/12.
excluded_note: resnet1d and crnn_gru EXCLUDED from this analysis: their whitened sex direction sat INSIDE the random-re-split null in the re-split control (not separable from an arbitrary 3-vs-9 grouping of the same 12 speakers), so there is no validated direction to project for them. Stated explicitly, not silently dropped.
